UPDATE sync_token
   SET usado_em = now()
 WHERE token_hash = encode(digest($1, 'sha256'), 'hex')
RETURNING username

-- Grava cada documento apenas se a revisao dele no servidor ainda for a que
-- o cliente viu (baseRevision). Quem chegou depois e devolvido como rejeitado
-- e o cliente refaz o ciclo.
WITH entrada AS (
  SELECT *
    FROM json_to_recordset($1::json)
      AS x(kind text, "docId" text, payload jsonb, "baseRevision" bigint, deleted boolean)
), atual AS (
  SELECT e.*, d.revision AS revisao_atual
    FROM entrada e
    LEFT JOIN sync_doc d ON d.kind = e.kind AND d.doc_id = e."docId"
), aceitos AS (
  SELECT * FROM atual
   WHERE COALESCE(revisao_atual, 0) = COALESCE("baseRevision", 0)
), gravados AS (
  INSERT INTO sync_doc (kind, doc_id, payload, deleted, revision, updated_at)
  SELECT kind, "docId", payload, COALESCE(deleted, false), nextval('sync_revision_seq'), now()
    FROM aceitos
  ON CONFLICT (kind, doc_id) DO UPDATE
     SET payload    = EXCLUDED.payload,
         deleted    = EXCLUDED.deleted,
         revision   = EXCLUDED.revision,
         updated_at = now()
  RETURNING kind, doc_id, revision
)
SELECT GREATEST(
         (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(revision), 0) FROM sync_doc),
         COALESCE((SELECT MAX(revision) FROM gravados), 0)
       ) AS revision,
       COALESCE(
         (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('kind', kind, 'docId', doc_id, 'revision', revision))
            FROM gravados),
         '[]'::json
       ) AS aceitos,
       COALESCE(
         (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('kind', kind, 'docId', "docId", 'revision', revisao_atual))
            FROM atual
           WHERE COALESCE(revisao_atual, 0) <> COALESCE("baseRevision", 0)),
         '[]'::json
       ) AS rejeitados
